estimates.assumptions: 1.25 kg raw skin-on bone-in chicken pieces (mix of legs and breasts); meat has no carbohydrates
2 tablespoons olive oil (28 g total); pure fat, zero carbs
3 cloves garlic, chopped (approx. 9 g); standard values ~33 g carbs/100 g
Pinch of saffron threads (approx. 0.2 g); negligible but non-zero carbs
125 ml dry sherry; ~1.5–2 g residual carbs per 100 ml in dry styles
200 ml chicken stock; typical commercial stock ~1 g carbs per 100 ml
1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves (approx. 3–4 g); standard herb values
50 g raisins; standard nutritional values for dried fruit (~80 g carbs/100 g)
2 tablespoons pine nuts (approx. 18 g); standard values ~20 g carbs/100 g
Handful of fresh parsley (approx. 12 g); standard herb values
